call_purpose: You reached out because your domain was not connecting and your funnel opened only on the FlexiFunnels link.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you deleted the old A record in your GoDaddy DNS settings and added a CNAME record (name www, with the value shown in your FlexiFunnels domain settings), saving both.
Your domain now shows as connected in FlexiFunnels, and your funnel opens on it.

covered.text: We explained that the SSL padlock can take a little time to appear.

customer_next_steps.text: Check whether the SSL padlock has appeared, and let us know if it has not.
